title: MPESB Pre-Nursing Selection Test PNST 2026 Admission Online Form
intro: Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board -MPESB has Released Official Notification for Online Application form for Pre-Nursing Selection Test (PNST) Examination 2026. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to MPESB PNST-2026 Admission. Online Apply Start On June 9, 2026 & Last Date for Application is June 23, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.

1. Aadhaar registration of the candidate is mandatory.

2. Candidates must bring an original photo identity card (any one of: Voter ID, PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, Driving License, or Passport). E-Aadhaar is valid only after UIDAI verification. Without original photo ID, entry will be denied.
3. Candidates must also carry their Aadhaar Card / e-Aadhaar / Aadhaar Photocopy / Aadhaar Number / Aadhaar VID along with the original photo ID.
4. Multi-level biometric verification is mandatory at entry and during the examination.
5. Candidates will be allowed entry only up to the reporting time mentioned on the admit card. Latecomers will not be permitted.
6. Use of electronic devices (digital watch, mobile phone, calculator, log table, sunglasses, cheating material, etc.) is strictly prohibited inside the examination hall.
7. Admit Card can be downloaded only using the online Application Number. Candidates must keep their application number safe.
8. Candidates must bring a Ball Point Pen and the downloaded Admit Card to the examination centre.
9. No candidate will be allowed to leave the examination hall until the examination is fully over.
10. Eligibility of candidates is provisional as certificates are not verified by MPESB at the time of application.
